# PHR-SERVICES

> Every page of the PHR-SERVICES module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [PHR application services](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services): Services a PHR application can offer on top of ABDM. Not a certification milestone.
- [1. First Search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-1-first-search): Searches for teleconsultation services by category. Beckn search action; results arrive at on_search.
- [1. on_search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-1-on-search): Callback carrying the teleconsultation providers and services that matched a search.
- [1. POST /api/blood-bank/search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-1-post-api-blood-bank-search): Searches for blood banks and blood availability. Beckn search action; results arrive at on_search.
- [2. on_search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-2-on-search): Callback carrying the teleconsultation providers and services that matched a search.
- [2. POST /api/blood-bank/on_search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-2-post-api-blood-bank-on-search): Callback carrying the blood banks and stock that matched a search.
- [2. Second Search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-2-second-search): Refines a teleconsultation search, for example by provider or time slot. Beckn search action; results arrive at on_search.
- [3. Init](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-3-init): Initialises a teleconsultation booking for the service selected. Beckn init action; the reply arrives at on_init.
- [3. on_init](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-3-on-init): Callback carrying the provider's reply to a teleconsultation init: the quote and the terms to confirm.
- [4. Confirm](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-4-confirm): Confirms a teleconsultation booking. Beckn confirm action; the reply arrives at on_confirm.
- [4.on_confirm](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-4-on-confirm): Callback carrying the provider's confirmation of a teleconsultation booking, with the order details.
- [5.On status](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-5-on-status): Callback carrying the current status of a teleconsultation order.
- [5. Status](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-5-status): Asks for the current status of a teleconsultation order. Beckn status action; the reply arrives at on_status.
- [6.on_cancel](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-6-on-cancel): Callback carrying the provider's reply to a teleconsultation cancellation.
- [6. On_update](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-6-on-update): Updates a teleconsultation order, for example to reschedule. Beckn update action; the reply arrives at on_update.
- [7 .On_message](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-7-on-message): Sends a message within a teleconsultation. Beckn message action.
- [7.on_update](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-7-on-update): Callback carrying the provider's reply to a teleconsultation update.
- [{{aarogya-setu-sandbox-url}}api/health/service/doctor/master/system-of-medicine](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-aarogya-setu-sandbox-url-api-health-service-doc-2): Lists the systems of medicine a doctor can be filtered by.
- [{{aarogya-setu-sandbox-url}}api/health/service/doctor/geo-location/search-within-radius](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-aarogya-setu-sandbox-url-api-health-service-doctor): Finds doctors within a radius of a point, filtered by name, speciality, facility ownership and type, with paging.
- [Create](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-create): Saves a place as a bookmark for the signed-in ABHA address, with a title, address and coordinates.
- [Delete](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-delete): Deletes one of the person's saved place bookmarks.
- [Get categories](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-categories): Lists the teleconsultation categories available to search in.
- [Get categories by id](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-categories-by-id): Returns one teleconsultation category by its id.
- [Get Category List](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-category-list): Lists the facility categories available for filtering a search.
- [get-coverage-eligibility](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-coverage-eligibility): Checks whether a person's insurance policy covers them, through the National Health Claims Exchange. The result arrives at on_check.
- [get details](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-details): Lists the person's scan and pay requests with the status, order number and transaction id of each.
- [Get Distinct Category List](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-distinct-category-list): Lists the distinct facility categories, with the care settings each offers.
- [Get Doctor Details](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-doctor-details): Lists the doctors at a facility, by the facility's search id.
- [Get Facility Details By Search ID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-facility-details-by-search-id): Returns a facility's registry entry by its search id, including its contact person and address.
- [Get Languanges](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-languanges): Lists the languages a doctor can be filtered by.
- [get Orders by ABHA id](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-orders-by-abha-id): Lists the teleconsultation orders placed by an ABHA address.
- [Get Orders by Abha Id and Type](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-orders-by-abha-id-and-type): Lists the teleconsultation orders of an ABHA address, filtered by order type.
- [Get Orders by ABHA id desc](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-orders-by-abha-id-desc): Lists the teleconsultation orders of an ABHA address, newest first.
- [get Orders by id](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-orders-by-id): Returns one teleconsultation order by its order id, with the service, the professional and the fulfilment time.
- [get-policies](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-policies): Lists the insurance policies held against an ABHA number. encryptedAbhaNumber is the ABHA number encrypted.
- [Get Specialists](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-specialists): Lists the specialities available for filtering a facility search.
- [Get Specialists Category List](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-specialists-category-list): Lists the specialities available for filtering a facility search.
- [get/summary](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-summary): Lists the person's bookmarked places in summary form: title, address and coordinates.
- [Get System of Medicine List](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-system-of-medicine-list): Lists the systems of medicine a facility can be filtered by.
- [getByAbhaAddress](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-getbyabhaaddress): Lists the places the signed-in ABHA address has bookmarked.
- [Get HFR Facility Details By Search ID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-hfr-facility-search-by-id): Looks up a facility by search ID in the Health Facility Registry (HFR), NHA's national registry of health facilities. This is a different registry from the...
- [nhcx-onsubscribe](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-nhcx-onsubscribe): Callback confirming a subscription to National Health Claims Exchange notifications.
- [notify status](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-notify-status): Returns the payment status of one scan and pay request, with the receipt link once paid.
- [on_check](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-on-check): Callback carrying the payer's answer to a coverage eligibility check.
- [On Search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-on-search): Callback carrying the PM-JAY empanelled facilities that matched a search.
- [on_submit](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-on-submit): Callback carrying the payer's answer to a policy search.
- [OPENORDER](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-openorder): Opens a scan and pay order after the person scans a facility's payment counter QR code.
- [order-status](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-order-status): Returns the status of a scan and pay order by its order number.
- [payment-order](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-payment-order): Creates the payment order for the procedures selected and returns the UPI intent to pay with.
- [Rest Search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-rest-search): Searches PM-JAY empanelled facilities and returns the results in the same call, without a callback.
- [search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-search): Searches a payer's records for a member's policy through the National Health Claims Exchange. The result arrives at on_submit.
- [Search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-search-2): Searches PM-JAY empanelled facilities. Beckn search action; results arrive at on_search.
- [search-doctor-by-id](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-search-doctor-by-id): Returns a doctor's registry profile by their ABHA number: registration, qualifications, system of medicine and experience.
- [Search Facilities Within Radius](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-search-facilities-within-radius): Finds health facilities within a radius of a point, filtered by ownership, speciality and facility type, with paging.
- [Search Facilities Within Radius](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-search-facilities-within-radius-alt): The same facility-radius search as phr_services_search_facilities_within_radius in this file. Request and response are identical. NHA's Postman collection...
- [STEP 1 - search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-step-1-search): Searches for ambulance services. Beckn search action; results arrive at on_search.
- [STEP 2 - on_search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-step-2-on-search): Callback carrying the ambulance providers and services that matched a search.
- [STEP 3 - init](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-step-3-init): Initialises an ambulance booking for the service selected from search results. Beckn init action; the reply arrives at on_init.
- [STEP 4 - on_init](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-step-4-on-init): Callback carrying the provider's reply to an ambulance booking init: the quote and the terms to confirm.
- [subscribe](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-subscribe): Subscribes the PHR to National Health Claims Exchange notifications. Confirmation arrives at on_subscribe.
- [Update](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-update): Updates the title or address of a saved place bookmark.
- [update payment](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-update-payment): Records the outcome of a scan and pay payment: the amount, the transaction id and the receipt.
- [PHR application services errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-13/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/errors): What PHR application services returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
